title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Five-scene monumental Spaces engine
preserve: Map 5 strict maximum two visible signs

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v31 applies the latest cross-map feedback. Map 1 keeps its geometry but its green floor is visually removed and rendered pure black. Map 3 is byte-for-byte unchanged from v30. Map 4 keeps the same tunnel geometry/world anchoring but adds a stronger distance falloff plus a soft vanishing-throat darkness veil so near surfaces read clearer and far surfaces fall into black. Map 5 narrows again to roadHalf=.65 (full width 1.3), moves the towers farther laterally with gap=1.90, and clamps lateral movement to .42 while preserving radius=3.20, dark industrial background and bridge-last occlusion.

open_feedback: Review Map 1: floor should read essentially absent/black, while arches and backing architecture remain.
Review Map 4: near tunnel should feel clearer/brighter and depth should darken more aggressively toward the throat without breaking optical flow.
Review Map 5: bridge should feel thinner and main towers should pass farther from the player while retaining monumental scale.
